description: A text value — type it, or pass one in (valin-text); outputs it on val-text.
instructions:
A text value node — type a string, or wire a `val-*` string into `valin-text` to override it. Re-publishes the resolved string on `val-text` for downstream value consumers or the Output node. No geometry.

TIP: use it to label outputs, build captions, or pass a prompt / string through a flow.
